notes.title: Playtesters Wanted
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're looking for playtesters for the Steam version of this game. It'll run from today until May 4th and you can join by selecting "Request Access" on the store page. We're mainly looking for feedback on pacing, but any other thoughts are welcome. If you're part of it please post any feedback you have on the forums or send it to me via e-mail (kenny@kennysun.com). Also if you could record a video of yourself playing that'd be much appreciated!

Thanks!
